senses.gloss: m.(b. h. פְּתַלְתֹּל ; reduplic. of פתל) perverse; perverter.— Pl. פְּתַלְתּוֹלִים.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 308:3">Sifré Deut. 308</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:5">Deut. XXXII, 5</cite>) <he>עוקמנים אתם פ׳ אתם</he> you are tricksters, you are perverters; (Yalk. ib. 942 <he>פתלנים</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02185"><he>פַּתְלָן</he></cite>).
